Nina: AM async — what I did: spun up 4 extra GPU lanes in ams1, validated kernel patch on two test nodes, ran a small perf sweep (latency looks stable).
Raj: Nice. Any surprises on capacity after the spin-up?
Nina: We hit a soft quota on the AP spot pool when trying to add a fifth lane — cloud console blocked the request. Blocker: need a quota bump or fallback to on-demand for one lane.
Sam: I can kick off the quota request. Which exact quota/region? I assume `compute.googleapis.com/accelerator` for europe-west4?
Nina: europe-west4 (ams1). It's the NVIDIA A100 v4 accelerator quota. Request id I will paste into the ticket shortly.
Lea: FYI I saw 2 nodes in the warm pool with high preemption risk. If quota bump is delayed >30m, suggest we move one of the lanes to a dedicated on-demand instance to avoid churn.
Raj: Agreed. Can we update the autoscaler policy to prefer on-demand for the critical lanes? That avoids manual intervention.
Nina: Autoscaler patch is in review — PR #4628. Blocker: need one more lg to merge (pinged @Lea). If merged, policy flips automatically for new lanes.
Lea: On it, I'll review in the next 15. Quick note: logs show intermittent KV cache misses during the kernel rollout, not sure if it's config drift or patch.
Sam: deploy-bot: scheduled drain of node gpu-ams1-42 at 10:30 UTC for kernel rollout. (automated message)
Nina: Thanks @Sam. After the drain we'll monitor tail latencies. If KV misses persist, we'll revert the rollout for the partition.
Raj: I'll prepare the fallback route policy (route to quantized-2) and add a short-circuit in routing rules for affected tenants.
Lea: Ping once PR merged and quota ticket submitted — I'll coordinate the on-call shift handover.
Sam: Submitting quota request now, ticket #CI-7892, added justification + perf numbers. ETA from cloud ops ~2–4 hours.
Nina: Great. Today's plan: follow up on PR, watch the drain, and switch one lane to on-demand if quota stalls. Blocker: cloud ops ETA. :thumbsup:
